editionLabel: Renegade English rules with solo mode, ©2024
firstPlayerRule: In multiplayer, whoever has the greenest thumb goes first.
houseFallback: If your group cannot agree who has the greenest thumb, or prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Turns continue clockwise. Each player takes two actions, then draws back to four cards.
The four-player family variant uses teams, but players still take individual turns under the normal rules.
The Winter Lotus solo mode is a separate one-player challenge.
